remarks: Beautiful 2 Bedroom 1.5 bathroom tri-level Townhouse in desirable complex with inground pool. The main floor offers dining room, kitchen with stainless steel appliances, half bathroom and spacious living room w/ sliders to balcony. On the 2nd floor you will find the two spacious bedrooms, and full bathroom. Lower level offers a large bonus room, perfect for family room or home office, as well as laundry area and entrance to garage. Attached 1 Car garage, and one parking spot in front of garage. Conveniently located to parks, schools, public transportation, I95 and much more. Subject to probate approval.
